moments.description: A blank black screen is visible before the browser loads.
The "todos" application is open with an empty input box reading "What needs to be done?".
The todo list displays "Buy milk" with the counter showing "1 item left" and the "All" filter selected.
The todo list displays "Finish the hackathon demo video" and "Buy milk", with the counter showing "2 items left".
The todo list displays "Call mom", "Finish the hackathon demo video", and "Buy milk", with the counter showing "3 items left".
The todo list displays "Fix login bug", "Call mom", "Finish the hackathon demo video", and "Buy milk", with the counter showing "4 items left".
Four unchecked items are displayed in the list and the counter shows "4 items left" with the "All" filter selected.
"Fix login bug" is checked, the counter shows "3 items left", and the "Clear completed" button is visible.
"Fix login bug" and "Finish the hackathon demo video" are checked, and the counter shows "2 items left".
The list displays two checked items and two unchecked items with "2 items left" and the "All" filter selected.
The "Active" filter is highlighted, showing only active items "Call mom" and "Buy milk", with "2 items left".
The "Active" filter is highlighted with active items "Call mom" and "Buy milk" visible.
The "Completed" filter is highlighted, displaying checked items "Fix login bug" and "Finish the hackathon demo video".
The "All" filter is highlighted, displaying all four todo items, with the counter showing "2 items left".
The "All" filter is selected with all four items listed and the mouse hovering near the "Completed" button.
